_doc: Stream E (play-test 4, S9: 'more wandering merchants, quest givers and interesting NPCs along the roads'). Extra traveller `kinds` merged into data/provinces/travellers.json's kinds by js/sim/content.js and added to every route's allowed kinds (they walk the same routes, same rules). Extra fields stream A's travellers.js / roadevents.js read: `stopNear` = the group stands still while a player is within this many metres (so a shop or a talk is never cut off by them walking out of reach); `shop` = the shop kind the FIRST crew member sells from (a kind in `shops` below, or in shops.json); `offers: 'deliver'` = the first crew member hands out a delivery quest to a named NPC in the town the group is walking to (data/provinces/road-events.json `deliver` texts); `curious` = the first crew member shares a lore line from `lore` when talked to and, once per character per traveller, a small `tip` (gold, a good, or a rumour of something nearby). `shops` = shop kinds merged into shops.json's kinds (same format). Rules bump: `perRouteKm` overrides travellers.json's (more people on the road: one group about every 800 m of road, ~40% of them wanderers by weight). W5 (owner feedback 8): `ox_carter` = a cart for hire on the road — `offers: cart` opens the cart route window (data/provinces/carts.json `roaming`), `vehicle: ox_cart` is the model the group travels as (stream D-world). W27: a crew entry carries `titled` (true only for one that offers the player something).

pedlar.name: Wandering Pedlar
pedlar.blurb: Pots, pins, blades and blankets — all off the back of one donkey.

errand_runner.name: Errand Runner
errand_runner.blurb: Too many letters, not enough legs.

worried_parent.name: Worried Parent
worried_parent.blurb: Sending word ahead to family in town.

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.blurb: Knows a tale for every stone on this road.

hedge_scholar.name: Hedge Scholar
hedge_scholar.blurb: Measuring the barrows with a knotted string.

retired_soldier.name: Old Soldier
retired_soldier.blurb: Walks the road he once guarded, out of habit.

ox_carter.name: Longroad Cart
ox_carter.blurb: An ox cart for hire. It will take you to the next town, or any town, for a few coins.

pedlar.name: Pedlar's Pack
pedlar.says: Have a rummage. Mind the pins.

lore: They say the Downs were a sea once, and the barrows are the hulls of drowned ships turned over.
Never whistle on the causeway at dusk. Something in the reeds whistles back.
The waystones are older than Torborhold. Older than anyone's grandmother's grandmother.
A wolf that walks alone in daylight is either starving or not a wolf. Either way, walk faster.
The old toll at Hollin took one coin in ten. The bandits that took it over take ten in ten.
Bury your coin under a hawthorn and the dead won't touch it. The living will, mind.
Every fen light is a lantern somebody dropped. Don't go looking for who.
My grandfather swore the Saint at Orrin's Rise still walks, chains and all.

tips.say: Here — for listening to an old fool. Buy yourself something hot.
Take this. Road's long and the inns are dear.
A swallow for the road. Don't tell the innkeep where you got it.
Word is there's something nasty denning near {place}. Worth a look, if you're the sort.
